html:
G'oya

Xodimning maoshi bo'limdagi eng yuqori ikki maoshdan biri bo'ladi, agar shu bo'limda undan katta maoshlar bittadan ko'p bo'lmasa. Har bir xodim uchun bo'limdagi undan katta maoshlarni takrorsiz sanaymiz: 0 chiqsa u birinchi o'rinda, 1 chiqsa ikkinchi.

Yechim

SELECT department, name, salary
FROM employees e
WHERE (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e2.salary)
  FROM employees e2
  WHERE e2.department = e.department
    AND e2.salary > e.salary
) < 2

Namunada IT'da 9, 7 va 5 million. Sardorning 5 000 000 idan katta ikki xil maosh bor, u chiqmaydi. Savdoda ikki kishi, ikkalasi ham chiqadi.

Tuzoqlar

DISTINCT siz maoshlar emas, kishilar sanaladi. Maoshlar 900, 900, 800 bo'lsa, 800 oluvchidan yuqorida ikki kishi turadi va u chiqmay qoladi, holbuki 800 ikkinchi eng yuqori maosh:

Noto'g'riSELECT department, name, salary
FROM employees e
WHERE (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM employees e2
  WHERE e2.department = e.department
    AND e2.salary > e.salary
) < 2

e2.department = e.department ni unutsangiz, xodim butun kompaniya bilan solishtiriladi. Namunada Savdodagi Malika (6 000 000) IT'dagi ikki maoshdan past qoladi va natijadan tushib ketadi.

Boshqa yo'l

Window funksiyalarni o'rgangach, buni DENSE_RANK bilan yozish mumkin. U teng maoshlarga bir xil o'rin beradi va o'rinlar orasida bo'shliq qoldirmaydi, bu aynan "ikki xil maosh" ma'nosi:

SELECT department, name, salary
FROM (
  SELECT department, name, salary,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) AS r
  FROM employees
) t
WHERE r <= 2
